title: Perception or Prejudice: Can MLLMs Go Beyond First Impressions of Personality?

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the 'Prejudice Rate' (PR), defined as the frequency of a model correctly predicting a Big Five personality trait but failing to identify the correct observable behavioral cues grounding that judgment.

Calculating the standard deviation of the option-letter selection distribution in multiple-choice questions to detect if models disproportionately select specific option letters regardless of correctness.
Comparing the average scores assigned by an LLM-as-a-judge to models from its own family versus models from other families to detect within-family scoring inflation.
